verdict_reason: New per-page validator correctly encodes the contact-picker rules: fields() gates membership on addressOptions (present only where the page fetched the book), checks() distinguishes 'deleted since picked' from 'never answered' via the storedAnswers+stored gating, fromPayload/fromAnswers shapes match the controller and address-book payloads, and validate.test.js exhaustively covers onSubmit/onStored, no-book, tampered submits and stale-store cases; no findings.
